data.command: What security tools do you have deployed?

data.text:
We've got a few tools in place to keep things secure around here. Let me see if I can recall all of them... We've got Fail2Ban set up to block brute-force attempts on the SSH service. I think it's configured to use the system's logs to identify suspicious activity. And, of course, we've got the firewall rules in place to restrict incoming traffic to only the necessary ports.

As for network monitoring, we're using Nagios to keep an eye on system performance and alert us if anything goes awry. We've also got a custom script that runs on a schedule to scan for open SUID binaries... Oh, and I think we're using Tripwire to keep track of file system changes. That's what I can think of off the top of my head, anyway. (rummages through notes) Ah, yes, and we've also got the basic system logs turned on for auditing, of course.
